## What happened?

Describe the observed behavior and what you expected instead.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest sequence that reproduces the problem. Include the affected plan/run/tool/provider path when relevant.

## Logs / evidence

Paste sanitized logs, traceback, screenshots, or state transitions. Remove tokens, credentials, private email content, and personal learning data.

## Regression scope

Does this affect persisted state, migrations, tool calls, context/memory, scheduled work, or recovery/idempotency?
